title: Boom Castle TD
objective: Defend the castle wall from waves of advancing goblins and monsters using a manually aimed cannon and recruited tower heroes.
controls: Drag from the central cannon area towards enemies to aim and fire cannonballs; tap upgrade cards when prompted.
core_loop: Aim and fire cannonballs at advancing enemy waves to destroy them, earn upgrade selections, and strengthen castle defenses.
features: Red explosive barrels on the path
progression: Escalates through denser enemy waves, tougher armored enemies and large ogres, and periodic upgrade popups that unlock new heroes and boost cannon fire rate.
hook_idea: Cannonball hits the red explosive barrel in the middle of a goblin pack, triggering a massive shockwave explosion at t=19.4s.
